RequirementText: The system shall allow users to reset their password using an email verification token.
The system should be very fast.
The system shall respond within 2 seconds under standard operational workload.
Users can reset their password.
Users can change their forgotten password.
The system shall generate reports.
The administrator shall generate reports using PostgreSQL and export them to PDF format.
The platform shall provide interactive sales summary charts for quarterly reviews.
The system shall support at least 10,000 concurrent users.
The system should support a large number of users.
Database transactions shall maintain an average commit latency of under 50 milliseconds.
Passwords must contain at least 8 characters.
Passwords must contain a maximum of 6 characters.
All sensitive customer payment records must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 cipher standard.
The system shall enforce role-based access control (RBAC) for all administrative endpoints.
The system shall allow customers to track orders and view shipment status.
Customers shall receive real-time email notifications when their order status changes.
The application shall validate credit card numbers using the Luhn algorithm before submission.
The interface should be easy and user-friendly for novice shoppers.
The search bar shall return autocompleted product recommendations as the user types.
The system shall maintain 99.9% uptime during operational business hours.
The application must recover from unexpected server crashes within 60 seconds.
Users shall be able to filter search results by price range, brand, and customer ratings.
The cashier shall scan barcodes to add items to the customer basket.
The platform shall export audit logs to an external syslog server daily.
The user interface shall comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility guidelines.
The system shall process refunds within 3 to 5 business days upon administrative approval.
All network communications between client and server must use TLS 1.3 protocol.
The mobile app shall cache offline catalog items for up to 24 hours.
The system shall allow registered users to deactivate their account at any time.
